name: 井底余响
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original boss combat body for the 2D action RPG Abyss Salvager, abandoned-mine industrial fantasy. Premium hand-painted stylized game rendering, sculptural soft top-left light, charcoal iron, worn copper, ivory mineral edges, restrained emissive cores, broad readable forms and deliberately controlled texture. Match a coherent family of salvaged mining machinery and mineral-organic creatures, but create an entirely original boss. Camera: elevated three-quarter top-down view, looking down about 40 degrees, facing lower-right. Single full body in a grounded ready-to-fight pose. Entire body, tools and limbs visible with 10 percent clear transparent margin. Square canvas. Designed to be legible when displayed 140–180 pixels high: strong unique silhouette, few broad contrasting masses, iconic organs visible, no tiny tangled decoration. Truly transparent PNG alpha cutout, virtually opaque character interiors, narrow antialiased edges only. No background, black backdrop, gradient, floor, base, pedestal, ground shadow, scene props, text, glyphs, numbers, watermark, UI, borders, extra creatures, floating attack effects, baked warning rings or diagrams. No franchise resemblance. Subject BO04 Echo at the Well's End / 井底余响: a towering HOLLOW GREAT BELL made from cracked charcoal stone and ancient oxidized bronze, enclosing one clearly visible suspended warm ivory-amber MINER'S LANTERN inside its open arch. The lantern is the bright central weak point, no face. EXACTLY FOUR thick articulated STONE ARMS emerge from the bell's upper sides in two clearly separated pairs; EACH arm holds one complete smaller bell of a DISTINCT SIZE, all four side bells visible, with shapes spaced around the central hollow bell. Two upper arms spread higher and two lower arms spread wider, forming a broad solemn four-armed silhouette without a humanoid torso. Central bell mouth open toward lower-right, pale mineral fracture edges and restrained cyan resonance seams, broad dark stone masses, aged copper fittings. No feet are required: the heavy lower bell rim and arms form a self-contained hovering creature, but no cast ground shadow, floor or support base. Four limbs total, four side bells, one central big bell, one visible mining lantern. Ancient underground acoustic-machine mood, monumental and ominous, selective readable wear rather than noisy rubble; no external soundwave graphics.
postprocessing: None; source PNG and alpha copied unchanged.
limitations: Static body artwork only; does not constitute animation or boss gameplay acceptance.

visual_inspection: Four stone arms each hold one differently sized bell, surrounding one hollow central bell.
Suspended warm mining lantern visible within the central opening; broad cracked stone/bronze masses and complete bell rims.
qa.alpha_method: System.Drawing read-only GetPixel stride4; visible alpha>16, near-opaque alpha>=240; actual outermost edges checked at every pixel. No image pixels edited.
qa.runtime_scale_validation: Shape design and source checked; actual engine-scale rendering is owned by boss runtime integration and is not claimed here.
qa.limitations: A single static body, not direction variants, phase poses, attack animation, or complete boss gameplay.
